tools.name: invoiced_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (accounts receivable debtors): name, number, email, payment terms, currency, autopay and chasing settings, owner. Filter by open balance, saved payment method, update time or any exact-match column. GET /customers.

tools.name: invoiced_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, address, terms, currency, autopay, chasing cadence, credit hold/limit, parent customer, metadata. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_get_customer_balance
tools.description: A customer's current balance: total outstanding, past due, and available credit, in the customer's currency (or `currency`). GET /customers/{id}/balance.

tools.name: invoiced_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of one customer: name, title, email, phone, whether primary (copied on communications) and SMS-enabled. GET /customers/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: invoiced_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with number, customer, status (draft, not_sent, sent, viewed, past_due, pending, paid, voided), dates, totals, balance and line items. Filter by customer, paid flag, invoice date range, update time or any exact-match column. GET /invoices.

tools.name: invoiced_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id: status, dates, payment terms, totals, balance, line items, discounts, taxes, ship-to, payment and PDF links. `expand` replaces ids with full objects (e.g. customer). GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_get_invoice_payment_plan
tools.description: The payment plan (installments with dates, amounts and balances, and approval status) attached to an invoice. Errors with 404 when the invoice has none. GET /invoices/{id}/payment_plan.

tools.name: invoiced_list_payments
tools.description: List payments received: customer, date, amount, unapplied balance, method (check, wire, ACH, card, ...), reference, whether matched or voided. Read only. GET /payments.

tools.name: invoiced_get_payment
tools.description: One payment by id, including which invoices and credit notes it was applied to (`applied_to`). GET /payments/{id}?include=applied_to.

tools.name: invoiced_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes: customer, status (draft, open, paid, closed, voided), totals, remaining balance, line items. GET /credit_notes.

tools.name: invoiced_get_credit_note
tools.description: One credit note by id with line items, totals and balance. GET /credit_notes/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes): customer, status (draft, not_sent, sent, approved, invoiced, declined, voided), expiration date, deposit, totals, resulting invoice. GET /estimates.

tools.name: invoiced_get_estimate
tools.description: One estimate by id with line items, totals, deposit and approval state. GET /estimates/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_items
tools.description: List the item catalog (products and services): id, name, currency, unit cost, type, taxable. Use item ids as `catalog_item` when creating a draft invoice. GET /items.

tools.name: invoiced_get_item
tools.description: One catalog item by its id (a string such as "delivery"). GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_tax_rates
tools.description: List tax rates: id, name, value, whether a percentage, whether inclusive, currency. GET /tax_rates.

tools.name: invoiced_list_plans
tools.description: List subscription plans: id, name, currency, amount, pricing mode, billing interval, tiers. GET /plans.

tools.name: invoiced_get_plan
tools.description: One subscription plan by its id (a string). GET /plans/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions: customer, plan, quantity, billing period, status (not_started, active, past_due, finished, canceled), recurring total and MRR, contract renewal. GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: invoiced_get_subscription
tools.description: One subscription by id with plan, add-ons, billing period, contract terms, recurring total and MRR. GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: invoiced_list_notes
tools.description: List collection notes, newest first, for one customer or one invoice (give exactly one), or all notes when neither is given. GET /customers/{id}/notes, /invoices/{id}/notes or /notes.

tools.name: invoiced_list_tasks
tools.description: List collection tasks (call, letter, email, review): name, action, customer, assignee, due date, whether complete. GET /tasks.

tools.name: invoiced_list_events
tools.description: The activity feed, newest first: event type (such as invoice.paid, customer.created), time, the object it concerns and who did it. Optionally only the events of one object. GET /events.

tools.name: invoiced_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Invoiced. Nothing is sent to anyone and no money moves. Name is required; Invoiced generates the customer number unless given. POST /customers.

tools.name: invoiced_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice for a customer. It is always created as a draft: it is not issued, not emailed, not charged and cannot trigger AutoPay until a person finalizes it in Invoiced. At least one line item is required. POST /invoices with draft=true.

tools.name: invoiced_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a customer or an invoice (give exactly one). Notes are internal; nothing is sent. POST /notes.

tools.name: invoiced_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a collection task for a customer (a reminder to call, write, email or review). Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /tasks.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoiced_list_customers, invoiced_list_contacts, invoiced_list_tasks, invoiced_list_events · Private data: invoiced_get_customer, invoiced_list_contacts · Public sink: invoiced_list_customers, invoiced_list_contacts, invoiced_list_tasks, invoiced_create_customer, invoiced_create_draft_invoice, invoiced_add_note, invoiced_create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoiced_list_customers, invoiced_list_contacts, invoiced_list_tasks, invoiced_list_events · Private data: invoiced_get_customer, invoiced_list_contacts · Public sink: invoiced_list_customers, invoiced_list_contacts, invoiced_list_tasks, invoiced_create_customer, invoiced_create_draft_invoice, invoiced_add_note, invoiced_create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
